Stale key error: API_KEY_SERVICE_BLOCKED for places.googleapis.com SearchNearby AND AutocompletePlaces. maps.googleapis.com Geocoding API: REQUEST_DENIED 'API is not activated on your API project'. => the Places key/project config blocks Places API (New); a GCP Console change is required (owner action), not an app defect.

measurement_post_opt.flow: compose -> compact pan x2 -> sheet scroll -> expand -> 6 pans -> double-tap zoom -> drags -> collapse -> compact -> re-expand -> pans

part2_perf_optimization.reading: Modest aggregate improvement (raster med 7.86->7.20, total med 13.35->12.19, total p95 37.33->33.80, max 275->251). The optimization scopes 3D/buildings to expanded mode; the measurement window is expanded-dominant by design so the expanded-phase raster tail (still 3D-on) dominates the aggregate. compact-phase savings are real but small in a ~90s expanded-heavy window. totalMs>16.67 share is a timing descriptor, not a dropped-frame count.
